imo-1972-q1.summary: Ten distinct two-digit positive integers are given. Prove that one can choose two nonempty disjoint subsets of these integers whose sums are equal.
imo-1972-q1.summaryZh: 给定十个互不相同的两位正整数。证明可以从中选出两个非空且互不相交的子集，使两子集的元素和相等。
imo-1972-q1.answer: Such two disjoint nonempty subsets always exist.
imo-1972-q1.answerZh: 总能找到满足条件的两个非空不交子集。

methods.title: Compare the number of subsets with the possible sums
methods.titleZh: 比较子集数量与可能的和
steps: Let the given set be $S$. It has $2^{10}=1024$ subsets, including the empty set.
The largest possible sum of ten distinct two-digit integers is $90+91+\cdots+99=945$. Thus every subset sum is one of the $946$ integers from $0$ through $945$.
By the pigeonhole principle, two distinct subsets $A,B\subseteq S$ have the same sum.
Remove their common part: put $C=A\setminus B$ and $D=B\setminus A$. Then $C\cap D=\varnothing$ and $\sum C=\sum A-\sum(A\cap B)=\sum B-\sum(A\cap B)=\sum D$.
Because $A\ne B$, at least one of $C,D$ is nonempty. All elements of $S$ are positive, so equality of the two sums forces the other set to be nonempty as well. Hence $C,D$ are the required subsets.
stepsZh: 记所给集合为 $S$。包括空集在内，它共有 $2^{10}=1024$ 个子集。
十个互不相同的两位整数之和至多为 $90+91+\cdots+99=945$。因此任一子集和只能是 $0$ 到 $945$ 之间的 $946$ 个整数之一。
由抽屉原理，存在两个不同子集 $A,B\subseteq S$，它们的元素和相等。
删去公共部分，令 $C=A\setminus B$、$D=B\setminus A$。则 $C\cap D=\varnothing$，且 $\sum C=\sum A-\sum(A\cap B)=\sum B-\sum(A\cap B)=\sum D$。
因为 $A\ne B$，$C,D$ 中至少一个非空。又因 $S$ 中元素均为正数，两者和相等迫使另一个也非空。因此 $C,D$ 即为所求。

imo-1972-q2.summary: Let $n\ge4$. Prove that every cyclic quadrilateral can be partitioned into exactly $n$ quadrilaterals, each of which is cyclic.
imo-1972-q2.summaryZh: 设 $n\ge4$。证明任意圆内接四边形都能被分割成恰好 $n$ 个圆内接四边形。
imo-1972-q2.answer: First construct four cyclic pieces with one rectangular piece, then divide that rectangle into $n-3$ rectangles.
imo-1972-q2.answerZh: 先构造四个圆内接子四边形，其中一个为矩形，再把该矩形分成 $n-3$ 个矩形。

methods.title: Create a rectangular piece and subdivide it
methods.titleZh: 先构造矩形子块再细分
steps: It is enough to split a cyclic quadrilateral into four cyclic quadrilaterals, one a rectangle. Indeed, cutting that rectangle by $n-4$ segments parallel to one pair of sides replaces it by $n-3$ rectangles and produces $3+(n-3)=n$ cyclic pieces.

Let $ABCD$ be the original quadrilateral in cyclic order. If, say, $\angle A=90^\circ$, then $BD$ is a diameter and the circle centre $O$ lies inside $ABCD$. Join $O$ to the midpoint of each side. Every resulting piece has two opposite right angles and is cyclic; the piece at $A$ is a rectangle. This settles the right-angle case.

Assume now that no angle is right. Relabel cyclically so that $\angle A,\angle B$ are acute and $\angle C,\angle D$ are obtuse. Draw $AB$ horizontally with the quadrilateral above it. From $D$ draw the inward ray perpendicular to $AD$, and from $C$ the inward ray perpendicular to $BC$.

Choose a horizontal line just below the lower of $C,D$. It meets the first inward ray at $P$ and the second at $Q$, both inside the quadrilateral, and the line can be chosen so that $P$ lies to the left of $Q$. To see this explicitly, suppose $C$ is no higher than $D$: the ray from $D$ crosses the diagonal $AC$ below $C$, whereas the ray from $C$ begins at $C$; a sufficiently small downward shift therefore meets the two rays in the asserted order. The other height order is symmetric.

Let $E,F$ be the perpendicular projections of $P,Q$ onto $AB$. The acuteness of $A,B$ and the ray directions give the strict order $A,E,F,B$. Draw $DP,PE,PQ,QF,QC$. The four pieces are $AEPD$, $EFQP$, $FBCQ$, and $PQCD$; the middle one is a rectangle.
The first and third pieces are cyclic because $\angle ADP=\angle AEP=90^\circ$ and $\angle BCQ=\angle BFQ=90^\circ$.

For the last piece, write $\beta=\angle ABC$. Since $ABCD$ is cyclic, $\angle CDA=180^\circ-\beta$. Hence $\angle CDP=\angle CDA-90^\circ=90^\circ-\beta$. Also $CQ\perp BC$ and $QP\parallel BA$, so $\angle CQP=90^\circ+\beta$. These opposite angles sum to $180^\circ$, proving that $PQCD$ is cyclic.
Thus the required four-piece construction always exists, and the subdivision in the first step gives exactly $n$ cyclic quadrilaterals for every $n\ge4$.
stepsZh: 只需把一个圆内接四边形分成四个圆内接四边形，并使其中一个为矩形。事实上，在该矩形内作 $n-4$ 条平行于一组对边的线，可把它替换为 $n-3$ 个矩形，总块数变为 $3+(n-3)=n$。
设原四边形按圆周顺序为 $ABCD$。若某角（不妨为 $\angle A$）等于 $90^\circ$，则 $BD$ 是直径，圆心 $O$ 位于四边形内部。连接 $O$ 与四边中点，每一子块都有一对对角为直角，故均为圆内接四边形；含 $A$ 的子块还是矩形。
以下设没有直角。循环重标号，使 $\angle A,\angle B$ 为锐角，$\angle C,\angle D$ 为钝角。令 $AB$ 水平且四边形位于其上方。从 $D$ 向四边形内部作垂直于 $AD$ 的射线，从 $C$ 向内部作垂直于 $BC$ 的射线。
在 $C,D$ 中较低点的稍下方取一条水平线，使其分别与两条射线交于内部点 $P,Q$，并使 $P$ 位于 $Q$ 左侧。具体地，若 $C$ 不高于 $D$，则从 $D$ 出发的射线先在低于 $C$ 处穿过对角线 $AC$，而另一射线从 $C$ 出发；把过 $C$ 的水平线略向下平移即可得到所需次序。另一种高低关系完全对称。
把 $P,Q$ 向 $AB$ 作垂线，垂足分别为 $E,F$。由 $A,B$ 为锐角及两射线的方向可得严格次序 $A,E,F,B$。作线段 $DP,PE,PQ,QF,QC$，得到四块 $AEPD$、$EFQP$、$FBCQ$、$PQCD$，其中 $EFQP$ 是矩形。
第一块与第三块均为圆内接四边形，因为 $\angle ADP=\angle AEP=90^\circ$，且 $\angle BCQ=\angle BFQ=90^\circ$。

对最后一块，记 $\beta=\angle ABC$。原四边形圆内接，所以 $\angle CDA=180^\circ-\beta$，从而 $\angle CDP=\angle CDA-90^\circ=90^\circ-\beta$。又由 $CQ\perp BC$、$QP\parallel BA$，有 $\angle CQP=90^\circ+\beta$。这两个对角互补，故 $PQCD$ 也圆内接。
因此四块分割总能完成，再按第一步细分矩形，便对每个 $n\ge4$ 得到恰好 $n$ 个圆内接四边形。

imo-1972-q3.summary: For arbitrary nonnegative integers $m,n$, prove that $\dfrac{(2m)!(2n)!}{m!n!(m+n)!}$ is an integer, with $0!=1$.
imo-1972-q3.summaryZh: 对任意非负整数 $m,n$，证明 $\dfrac{(2m)!(2n)!}{m!n!(m+n)!}$ 是整数，其中 $0!=1$。
imo-1972-q3.answer: The displayed quantity is an integer for all $m,n\ge0$.
imo-1972-q3.answerZh: 该式对所有 $m,n\ge0$ 均为整数。

methods.title: Use a two-variable recurrence
steps: Write $S(m,n)=\dfrac{(2m)!(2n)!}{m!n!(m+n)!}$.
Direct cancellation gives $S(m+1,n)=\dfrac{2(2m+1)}{m+n+1}S(m,n)$ and $S(m,n+1)=\dfrac{2(2n+1)}{m+n+1}S(m,n)$. Adding yields the recurrence $$S(m+1,n)+S(m,n+1)=4S(m,n).$$
We induct on $n$, with the assertion required simultaneously for every $m\ge0$. At $n=0$, $S(m,0)=\dfrac{(2m)!}{m!m!}=\binom{2m}{m}$ is an integer.
Assume $S(m,n)$ is an integer for every $m\ge0$. Rearranging the recurrence gives $$S(m,n+1)=4S(m,n)-S(m+1,n),$$ an integer for every $m$ by the induction hypothesis.
The induction covers every $n\ge0$, proving the claim for all nonnegative $m,n$.
stepsZh: 直接约分得到 $S(m+1,n)=\dfrac{2(2m+1)}{m+n+1}S(m,n)$ 以及 $S(m,n+1)=\dfrac{2(2n+1)}{m+n+1}S(m,n)$。两式相加得递推式 $$S(m+1,n)+S(m,n+1)=4S(m,n).$$
对 $n$ 归纳，并在每一步同时证明所有 $m\ge0$ 的结论。当 $n=0$ 时，$S(m,0)=\dfrac{(2m)!}{m!m!}=\binom{2m}{m}$ 是整数。
假设固定的 $n$ 下，所有 $S(m,n)$ 都是整数。由递推式改写为 $$S(m,n+1)=4S(m,n)-S(m+1,n),$$ 右边由归纳假设为整数，因此对每个 $m$ 都成立。
归纳覆盖所有 $n\ge0$，所以结论对任意非负整数 $m,n$ 成立。

imo-1972-q4.summary: Positive real numbers $x_1,\ldots,x_5$ satisfy, with indices read cyclically modulo $5$, $$(x_i^2-x_{i+2}x_{i+4})(x_{i+1}^2-x_{i+2}x_{i+4})\le0\qquad(i=1,\ldots,5).$$ Determine all such five-tuples.
imo-1972-q4.summaryZh: 正实数 $x_1,\ldots,x_5$ 满足（下标按模 $5$ 循环）$$(x_i^2-x_{i+2}x_{i+4})(x_{i+1}^2-x_{i+2}x_{i+4})\le0\qquad(i=1,\ldots,5).$$ 求所有这样的五元组。

methods.title: Linearise the signs with logarithms and sum
methods.titleZh: 用对数线性化符号并求和
steps: Put $a_i=\ln x_i$ and read all subscripts modulo $5$. Since the logarithm is strictly increasing, $x_j^2-x_kx_l$ has the same sign as $2a_j-a_k-a_l$.
Hence the five hypotheses become $$(2a_i-a_{i+2}-a_{i+4})(2a_{i+1}-a_{i+2}-a_{i+4})\le0\qquad(i=1,\ldots,5).$$
Add their left sides. Expanding and collecting cyclic terms gives $$\sum_{i=1}^5(2a_i-a_{i+2}-a_{i+4})(2a_{i+1}-a_{i+2}-a_{i+4})=\sum_{i=1}^5(a_i-a_{i+2})^2.$$
The left side is nonpositive because each summand is nonpositive, whereas the right side is nonnegative. Therefore every square is zero: $a_i=a_{i+2}$ for all $i$.
Because adding $2$ cycles through all five residues, $a_1=a_2=\cdots=a_5$ and hence $x_1=\cdots=x_5=t>0$. Conversely, such a tuple makes every factor zero, so all and only these tuples are solutions.
stepsZh: 令 $a_i=\ln x_i$，所有下标按模 $5$ 循环。由于对数严格递增，$x_j^2-x_kx_l$ 与 $2a_j-a_k-a_l$ 同号。
左边因每一项非正而非正，右边则为非负平方和。因此每个平方都等于零，即对所有 $i$ 有 $a_i=a_{i+2}$。
模 $5$ 反复加 $2$ 会遍历全部下标，所以 $a_1=a_2=\cdots=a_5$，进而 $x_1=\cdots=x_5=t>0$。反过来，这样的五元组使原式每个因子都为零，故这就是全部解。

imo-1972-q5.summary: Real-valued functions $f,g$ satisfy $f(x+y)+f(x-y)=2f(x)g(y)$ for all real $x,y$. Assume $f$ is not identically zero and $|f(x)|\le1$ for every $x$. Prove that $|g(y)|\le1$ for every real $y$.
imo-1972-q5.summaryZh: 实值函数 $f,g$ 对所有实数 $x,y$ 满足 $f(x+y)+f(x-y)=2f(x)g(y)$。已知 $f$ 不恒为零，且对每个 $x$ 都有 $|f(x)|\le1$。证明对每个实数 $y$ 都有 $|g(y)|\le1$。

methods.title: Take the supremum of the bounded function
methods.titleZh: 利用有界函数的上确界
steps: Let $M=\sup_{t\in\mathbb R}|f(t)|$. The assumptions give $0<M\le1$.
Fix $y$. For every $x$, the functional equation and triangle inequality give $$2|f(x)|\,|g(y)|=|f(x+y)+f(x-y)|\le |f(x+y)|+|f(x-y)|\le2M.$$
Taking the supremum over $x$ on the left yields $2M|g(y)|\le2M$. Since $M>0$, division gives $|g(y)|\le1$.
The choice of $y$ was arbitrary, so the bound holds on all of $\mathbb R$.
stepsZh: 令 $M=\sup_{t\in\mathbb R}|f(t)|$。由题设可知 $0<M\le1$。
固定任意 $y$。对每个 $x$，由函数方程和三角不等式，$$2|f(x)|\,|g(y)|=|f(x+y)+f(x-y)|\le |f(x+y)|+|f(x-y)|\le2M.$$
对左端关于 $x$ 取上确界，得到 $2M|g(y)|\le2M$。因为 $M>0$，相除即得 $|g(y)|\le1$。
$y$ 的选择任意，故该界对所有实数 $y$ 成立。

methods.title: Build a sequence that would grow if $|g(y)|>1$
methods.titleZh: 构造在 $|g(y)|>1$ 时增长的序列
steps: Fix $y$ and choose $x_0$ with $f(x_0)\ne0$. From $|f(x+y)+f(x-y)|=2|f(x)|\,|g(y)|$, at least one of $|f(x+y)|,|f(x-y)|$ is at least $|f(x)|\,|g(y)|$.
Starting at $x_0$, choose $x_{k+1}$ to be either $x_k+y$ or $x_k-y$ so that $$|f(x_{k+1})|\ge |g(y)|\,|f(x_k)|.$$
Induction gives $|f(x_k)|\ge |g(y)|^k|f(x_0)|$. If $|g(y)|>1$, the right side eventually exceeds $1$, contradicting the global bound $|f|\le1$.
Thus $|g(y)|\le1$ for the fixed $y$, and hence for every real $y$.
stepsZh: 固定 $y$，并选取满足 $f(x_0)\ne0$ 的 $x_0$。由 $|f(x+y)+f(x-y)|=2|f(x)|\,|g(y)|$ 可知，$|f(x+y)|,|f(x-y)|$ 中至少一个不小于 $|f(x)|\,|g(y)|$。
归纳得到 $|f(x_k)|\ge |g(y)|^k|f(x_0)|$。若 $|g(y)|>1$，右端最终会超过 $1$，与全局条件 $|f|\le1$ 矛盾。
故固定的 $y$ 必满足 $|g(y)|\le1$；由于 $y$ 任意，结论对所有实数成立。

imo-1972-q6.summary: Four distinct parallel planes are given in three-dimensional space. Prove that a nondegenerate regular tetrahedron can be positioned with one vertex on each plane.
imo-1972-q6.summaryZh: 三维空间中给定四个互不相同的平行平面。证明可以放置一个非退化正四面体，使每个平面上恰有其一个顶点。
imo-1972-q6.answer: Such a regular tetrahedron exists for every four distinct parallel planes.
imo-1972-q6.answerZh: 对任意四个不同的平行平面，都存在满足条件的正四面体。

methods.title: Rotate and scale a vector model of a regular tetrahedron
methods.titleZh: 旋转并缩放正四面体的向量模型
steps: Choose coordinates so that the planes are $z=h_i$ for pairwise distinct real numbers $h_1,h_2,h_3,h_4$. Put $m=(h_1+h_2+h_3+h_4)/4$ and $t_i=h_i-m$, so $\sum t_i=0$.

Use the four vectors $$v_1=(1,1,1),\ v_2=(1,-1,-1),\ v_3=(-1,1,-1),\ v_4=(-1,-1,1).$$ Their endpoints form a regular tetrahedron because $|v_i-v_j|=2\sqrt2$ for $i\ne j$. They also satisfy $v_i\cdot v_i=3$ and $v_i\cdot v_j=-1$ for $i\ne j$.
Define $w=\frac14\sum_{j=1}^4t_jv_j$. Then $$w\cdot v_i=\frac14\left(3t_i-\sum_{j\ne i}t_j\right)=t_i,$$ using $\sum t_j=0$. Since the $h_i$ are not all equal, $w\ne0$; set $r=|w|>0$.
Let $e_3=(0,0,1)$ and choose a rotation $R$ with $R(w/r)=e_3$. Rotations preserve dot products, hence $$e_3\cdot Rv_i=R(w/r)\cdot Rv_i=(w\cdot v_i)/r=t_i/r.$$
Define points $p_i=rRv_i+me_3$. Their vertical coordinates are $e_3\cdot p_i=t_i+m=h_i$, so $p_i$ lies on the prescribed plane $z=h_i$.
All mutual distances are $|p_i-p_j|=r|v_i-v_j|=2\sqrt2r$. Therefore the four $p_i$ form a nondegenerate regular tetrahedron, with one vertex on each given plane.
stepsZh: 选取坐标系，使四个平面的方程为 $z=h_i$，其中实数 $h_1,h_2,h_3,h_4$ 两两不同。令 $m=(h_1+h_2+h_3+h_4)/4$、$t_i=h_i-m$，于是 $\sum t_i=0$。
定义 $w=\frac14\sum_{j=1}^4t_jv_j$。利用 $\sum t_j=0$，有 $$w\cdot v_i=\frac14\left(3t_i-\sum_{j\ne i}t_j\right)=t_i.$$ 因各 $h_i$ 不全相同，$w\ne0$；记 $r=|w|>0$。
令 $e_3=(0,0,1)$，选取旋转 $R$ 使 $R(w/r)=e_3$。旋转保持数量积，所以 $$e_3\cdot Rv_i=R(w/r)\cdot Rv_i=(w\cdot v_i)/r=t_i/r.$$
定义点 $p_i=rRv_i+me_3$。它的竖直坐标为 $e_3\cdot p_i=t_i+m=h_i$，故 $p_i$ 位于指定平面 $z=h_i$ 上。
任意两点间距离均为 $|p_i-p_j|=r|v_i-v_j|=2\sqrt2r$。因此四点构成非退化正四面体，并且每个给定平面上各有一个顶点。
